// ── COLOUR PALETTE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#let accent   = rgb("#1a3a5c")   // deep navy

#let light    = rgb("#888888")

#let section-title(t) = {
  v(0.6em)
  text(font: "Liberation Sans", size: 11pt, weight: "bold", fill: accent, upper(t))
  line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.5pt + accent)
  v(0.25em)
}

#let job(title, org, period, desc) = {
  grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    text(weight: "bold", title),
    text(fill: light, size: 9pt, period)
  )
  text(fill: muted, style: "italic", org)
  v(0.2em)
  text(desc)
  v(0.5em)
}

#let case(title, meta, result, desc, tech) = {
  grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    text(weight: "bold", title),
    text(fill: light, size: 8.5pt, meta)

  v(0.12em)
  text(weight: "bold", fill: accent, result)
  v(0.12em)
  text(size: 9.5pt, desc)
  v(0.12em)
  text(size: 8.5pt, fill: light, tech)
  v(0.65em)
}

#let service(name, desc) = {

    columns: (4.2cm, 1fr),
    gutter: 0.6em,

// ── PROFILE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#section-title("Profile")

I'm a freelance data scientist who spent a decade on the floor of one of Europe's busiest container terminals before I ever touched a model — operating quay cranes, driving straddle carriers, managing live cargo flows. I build the data and ML systems that maritime and terminal operations actually need, from someone who has run those operations himself.

I work at the intersection of heavy industry and modern data engineering: integration layers for legacy terminal operating systems, predictive models for live vessel operations, real-time digital twins, and reinforcement learning for container optimisation. I don't do mystery — you'll know what I'm building, why, and where it stands. I ask the uncomfortable questions early, so they don't become expensive problems later. If you need someone who understands your operations before touching your data, we'll get along well.

#v(0.8em)
// ── DOMAIN EXPERTISE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#section-title("Domain Expertise — My Edge")

Over a decade of hands-on experience across the full operational hierarchy of a large container terminal — dockworker, straddle carrier driver, ship-to-shore crane operator. I understand the workflows, physical constraints, and failure modes that never appear in a manual: berth planning, yard density management, equipment choreography under vessel deadlines, and the human factors that decide whether a shift runs smoothly. For a data project that means I can tell the difference between a number that looks right and one that is operationally true — and I won't burn a client's budget modelling the wrong problem.
